description_en: Switches the primary and secondary nodes for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 切换MongoDB实例中的主备节点
name: SwitchDBInstanceHA

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

You must specify this parameter if you set the DBInstanceId parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点的ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the roles who switch the primary and secondary nodes for the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/123802.html operation to view the IDs and information of roles of nodes.



Separate role IDs with commas (,). If this parameter is not specified, the primary and secondary nodes are switched.

If you set the DBInstanceId parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, the roles who switch the primary and secondary nodes for the instance must belong to one shard node
parameters.help_zh:
需要执行切换的角色ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/123802.html接口获取角色ID和节点角色信息。

角色ID以英文逗号（,）分隔，不传入本参数则切换主备节点。
当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，执行切换的角色必须属于同一Shard节点中
parameters.name: role_ids

parameters.help_en:
The time when the primary and secondary nodes are switched. Valid values:

0: The primary and secondary nodes are immediately switched.

1: The primary and secondary nodes are switched during the O\&M time period
parameters.help_zh:
切换主备节点的时间点。取值：
0：立即切换。
1：在可运维时间段内切换
parameters.name: switch_mode
